zone.title: Am I in an evacuation zone?
zone.body: Check a location against tsunami evacuation zones. This works offline.
zone.naturalWarningSource: Source: National Weather Service tsunami safety guidance
zone.inZone: You are in a tsunami evacuation zone
zone.notInZone: You are outside the mapped tsunami evacuation zones
zone.outsideCoverage: This location is outside the area our zone data covers, so we can't tell you.

alerts.title: Weather alerts
alerts.body: Live alerts from the National Weather Service are coming soon.

plan.title: Family emergency plan
plan.body: Your household checklist, meeting points, and emergency contacts are coming soon.

safety.naturalWarning: If you feel a strong earthquake or see the ocean suddenly pull back, move inland or to high ground right away. Do not wait for an official warning.
safety.inZone: If a tsunami warning is issued, leave this zone right away. Go inland or to high ground, on foot if you can.
safety.notInZone: Being outside a mapped zone does not guarantee you are safe. Always follow instructions from emergency officials.
safety.placesDisclaimer: Distances are straight-line, not driving or walking routes. Shelters open only for specific emergencies, so check official announcements before you go.

location.unavailable: Couldn't get your location. You can enter coordinates instead.

location.invalid: Enter a latitude between -90 and 90 and a longitude between -180 and 180.
